db:migrate.description: Schema migrations and migration metadata only.

db:setup.description: Migrations plus labelled reference/demo catalogue rows; never demo identities.

db:seed:dev.description: Local/test-only identity seed with generated credentials and explicit opt-in.

db:reset.description: No destructive reset automation. Recreate a disposable database and rerun the explicit commands.

backupAndRestore.preferredRecovery: Recreate a throwaway local database from db:configure, then apply db:migrate and the explicit seed commands.

representativeDataCheck.command: npm run catalogue:selftest && npm run accessories:selftest && npm run africa:selftest
representativeDataCheck.note: Offline representative-data checks; they do not validate licensed supplier data.

procedure: Stop the API and record the current migration rows, embedding mode and database role.
Take a backup or discard the entire disposable database; never improvise a down migration.
For a failed forward migration, confirm schema_migrations has no row for that file and rerun db:migrate after a corrected forward file is reviewed.
For an embedding-mode mismatch, recreate the disposable database or align EMBEDDING_MODE with the recorded physical column type.
Re-run representative-data checks and npm run ci:verify before resuming local verification.

evidenceGaps: No dedicated production migration role or credential is configured.
No production backup, restore or point-in-time recovery drill has been executed.
No staging migration run or manual evidence is attached to this workspace.
No licensed or verified catalogue data is included in the representative-data checks.
